methods.notes: The source reports only reduced sample pressures, not the corresponding neon lattice parameters.

recalculation.notes: The low-pressure Mao ruby equation is executable, but neither ruby wavelength shifts nor neon lattice parameters are tabulated. The nine high-pressure rows therefore cannot be recalculated observation by observation from the Hemley neon calibration.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the final publisher article, both official Wiley auxiliary text files, and the cited same-batch Jackson et al. characterization. The complete rounded table supports coefficient-level BM2 parity under pressure-uncertainty weighting.

locations: article abstract, Methods paragraphs 4-7, and Results paragraphs 8-13
Jackson et al. (2004), doi:10.1029/2004GL019918, same-batch sample description and Table 1
primary_source_check.finding: The source defines two conventional-cell room-temperature EOS fits to one Fe-free Al.05-Pv specimen: a preferred two-free-parameter BM2 and a three-free-parameter BM3. Both use the complete 42-row table and the same explicit mixed ruby/neon pressure coordinate.

primary_data_check.finding: All 42 printed pressure, pressure-error, a-b-c lattice, lattice-error, conventional-cell-volume, and volume-error observations are directly transcribed. All rows are selected because the source reports no exclusions.

independent_refit.objective: least-squares pressure residuals divided by the row pressure uncertainties expanded from the auxiliary table's last-digit error columns
independent_refit.notes: Rounded observations recover both coefficients within 0.4 published standard deviations; scaled refit errors round to the reported 0.008 A^3 and 1.3 GPa, and the refit correlation is close to the reported -0.45. The article names a weighting scheme but does not print its objective, so this matching reconstruction is not asserted to be the authors' exact software implementation.

unresolved_issues: The article does not identify fit software or state the algebraic weighting objective; the pressure-uncertainty-weighted reconstruction is selected because it reproduces coefficients, errors, and correlation from the rounded table.
No row-wise ruby shifts or neon lattice parameters are published, so pressures cannot be independently recalculated.
No Al site occupancies or specimen fractional coordinates are published; the material stores an explicit MgSiO3 positional-topology proxy only.
The auxiliary files do not state a data reuse license.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: article abstract, Methods paragraphs 4-7, and Results paragraphs 8-13; official Wiley grl18465-sup-0001-README.txt; official Wiley grl18465-sup-0002-TABLE1.txt; Jackson et al. (2004), doi:10.1029/2004GL019918, same-batch sample description and Table 1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Article abstract and Results paragraph 8: second-order Birch-Murnaghan room-temperature EOS. Peritheos uses the standard Eulerian BM2 form, for which K0_prime=4 is a structural constraint rather than a stored free parameter.
parameter_provenance.V0: Article abstract: fitted conventional-cell V0=163.234(8) A^3; Results rounds this to 163.23(1) A^3.
parameter_provenance.K0: Article abstract and Results paragraph 8: fitted KT0=251.5(13) GPa.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Article abstract and Results: ambient-temperature/room-pressure coefficients; encoded operationally as 300 K, matching the source's comparison calculations at 300 K.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: All 42 observations in official auxiliary Table 1; the article states that the fit used the data and gives no exclusions.
